assumptions.statement: The actual SVG requires curved-path interpretation outside the inspected reader subset.
Controlled product requirements, tolerances, thickness and authenticated source-to-derivative design equivalence have not been provided.
Cut intent, contour order/multiplicity, axis/orientation, placement, workholding and kerf require applicable design/process review; a zero-origin label is not calibration evidence.
Actual stock identity/grade/thickness and applicable machine/material/process evidence are missing; synthetic verified flags and empty settings cannot supply parameters.
Beam-risk evidence for the applicable machine, guards/interlocks, site and authorized operator is unresolved; no activation or bypass is permitted.
Process-emission and ventilation evidence for the actual material/process/site is independently unresolved, regardless of beam review or generic known-status labels.
Exact offline cut-path/output verification and qualified current-context human approval have not been supplied.

verification.summary: Partial geometry/context evidence only; design intent, path/process applicability, beam and emission review, site context and qualified approval are unresolved.

simulation.reason: No applicable offline path/output verification has been supplied; partial source-contour inspection is not a verified manufacturing process.
required_checks: Compare exact output geometry, physical scale, placement and axes against the controlled design.
Review per-path cut/score/mark intent, order, multiplicity and applicable kerf/process evidence.
Review the exact intended consumer/controller output and applicable machine/material/site context with qualified humans; do not run physical equipment.

human_review.action: Use a reviewed applicable consumer/adapter or obtain a controlled supported alternative with explicit geometry-loss review. Do not remove the curved path or borrow the baseline measurements to clear the blocker. Resolve all baseline design, beam, emissions, process and offline-verification gaps before any new scoped approval.
human_review.reviewer_role: Qualified design and laser-process reviewers with responsible site/operator review
